title: Simultaneous Linear Equations
seo_title: Simultaneous Equations – JSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Solve simultaneous linear equations in two unknowns by elimination and substitution; solve word problems. (summary of the NERDC JSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 3 maths worksheets on simultaneous equations: elimination by adding or subtracting, multiplying first, substitution and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Make the coefficients of one letter the same, then add or subtract the equations to eliminate it.
  • Solve for the other letter, then substitute back to find the first one.
  • Check the answer in both equations.

Examples

Example

x + y = 10, x − y = 4

Add: 2x = 14

Answer: x = 7, y = 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding when the signs are the sameSubtract when the coefficients have the same sign.
Multiplying only one sideMultiply every term.
Checking in one equation onlyCheck both.

faq.a: Replacing a letter by an expression equal to it.
